The '''Medallion of Bravery''' was an award issued by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to civilians who demonstrated valor and bravery beyond the call duty and at significant personal risk. One variant of the award was marked with [[Color/Legends|silver]] [[Comet/Legends|comets]] and a senior version was marked with [[Gold/Legends|gold]] comets, eligible only to individuals whom had previously been awarded the Medallion of Bravery with silver comets. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were also among those eligible to receive the award.<ref name="Lockdown on Soboll" />
